mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace (id, name, description, primary_cluster_id, namespace, service_account_name, volcano_queue_name, max_pods, created_by, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{primaryClusterId}, #{namespace}, #{serviceAccountName}, #{volcanoQueueName}, #{maxPods}, #{createdBy}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, max_pods = #{maxPods}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM workspace ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO workspace_member (workspace_id, user_id) KEY(workspace_id, user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
